sources.title: IGNOU, Unit 19: Clans and Confederacies in Western India
sources.note: Printed pages 230 to 231, forts, interclan marriage and changing rajaputra status. Indexed original PDF checked; direct fetch unavailable.

sources.title: Athira K Babu, Kiradu inscription of Somesvara, VS 1218 (1161 CE), PMR 94
sources.note: 2026 scholarly digital transcription after H. V. Trivedi 1978 no. 94. Full PMR94.txt preview read successfully earlier; later access intermittent. Line 25 contains unbracketed praśastimakarodetāṃ narasiṃho nṛpājñayā. Modern Devanagari rendering is explicitly a transcription, not a facsimile. Group with the inscription editions and Trivedi corpus for budgets. Upgrade review reopened the full PMR94.txt preview and directly verified line 25, Sanskrit/Nagari metadata and damaged-letter conventions.

sources.title: Bisheshwar Nath Reu, Kiradu inscription of Kumarapala and Somesvara, Indian Antiquary 61 (1932)
sources.note: Printed pp. 135 onward: Sanskrit and English account. Indexed original explicitly translates composition by Narasimha at the king’s order and restoration under Kumarapala. Same underlying Kiradu inscription as PMR94.

sources.title: H. V. Trivedi, Corpus Inscriptionum Indicarum: Jalor inscription of Visala
sources.note: ASI corpus reproduced by What Is India. Lines 11 to 12: queen Melaradevi golden cupola. Editor converts date to 25 June 1118; older Reu edition has variant calendar reading. Public copy uses early twelfth century. Group conservatively with Trivedi/Kiradu work.

sources.title: Permanent Delegation of India to UNESCO, The Bhojeshwar Mahadev Temple, Bhojpur
sources.note: 2024 Tentative List submission, not an inscribed World Heritage property. Description supports eleventh-century Bhoja, unfinished temple, incised plans, blocks, ramps, dam remains and 1950 ASI excavation. Avoid oversized/superlative claims.

sources.title: Hansmukh Seth and J. S. Kharakwal, Jain Evidences Discovered from Excavations at Chandravati
sources.note: Primary excavation researchers: 2013 to 2016 seasons, Ambaji marble, high platforms; figure 17 twelfth/thirteenth-century ritual queue; figure 33 woman with anklet same date. Do not repeat weak inference from scarcity of bones to population-wide vegetarianism. Later mother/child and bathing figures excluded.

sources.title: Anil K. Pokharia and colleagues, Variable monsoons and human adaptations (2020)
sources.note: The Holocene 30(9), 1332 to 1344. Author-institution full PDF, manuscript pp. 4 to 6, Table 1, Figure 2 and Phase II crop counts; discussion and conclusion on multicausal change. Same work as DOI 10.1177/0959683620919976 and WUSTL/ResearchGate mirrors.

sources.title: National Museum, Delhi: Saraswati from Pallu
sources.note: Printed p. 70, accession 1-6/278, Chauhan, twelfth century, 77 cm high. Original indexed PDF description verified; direct PDF timeout. Use book and rosary, avoid conflicting total count of hands/objects.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre, Hill Forts of Rajasthan
sources.note: Statement of Outstanding Universal Value: eighth to eighteenth centuries; urban centres and temples, water harvesting, Jaisalmer continuing population. Many standing elements later than this atlas window, explicitly distinguished.

batchIdentityNotes.decision: Explicit shared-card upgrade of rajput-kingdoms, approved by root after identity inspection. Not a historical entity alias.
batchIdentityNotes.reason: Interleaved broad atlas labels for related northwestern ruling networks. Existing detailed local dossier already includes the intervening twelfth century. Shared narrative is more honest than a second synthetic Hindu state. The page explicitly rejects common government and uniform religion; contemporary Jain evidence is retained.
batchIdentityNotes.limits: Ancient hindu-kingdoms (-500 to 800) remains separate, as do specific dynasties. Bhojpur and Chandravati outside the middle outline are explicitly identified as regional comparisons. Imported dates are not founding/fall dates. All 17 substantive passages are preserved verbatim; only overview, phases, summaries and ending are updated.
